def get_encoder_param_groups(vla):
    groups = []
    bb = vla.vision_backbone
    for i, block in enumerate(bb.featurizer.blocks):
        groups.append((f"dino_{i}", list(block.parameters())))
    if hasattr(bb, "fused_featurizer"):
        for i, block in enumerate(bb.fused_featurizer.blocks):
            groups.append((f"siglip_{i}", list(block.parameters())))
    return groups


def compute_layer_stats(action_grads, aux_grads=None):
    flat_a = torch.cat([g.float().reshape(-1) for g in action_grads])
    stats = {"action_grad_norm": flat_a.norm().item()}
    if aux_grads is not None:
        flat_x = torch.cat([g.float().reshape(-1) for g in aux_grads])
        stats["aux_grad_norm"] = flat_x.norm().item()
        stats["cosine_similarity"] = F.cosine_similarity(
            flat_a.unsqueeze(0), flat_x.unsqueeze(0)
        ).item()
        stats["conflict_rate"] = ((flat_a * flat_x) < 0).float().mean().item()
    return stats
